notice: All cards, balances, values, collateral, merchant offers, auctions, rewards, and inventory shown here are demonstrations. They are not active credit, legal tender, deposits, securities, loans, prepaid accounts, or guaranteed goods.

cards.name: Good Bee Honey Card
cards.surface: Gold-honey physical card or coin with revocable NFC credential
cards.purpose: Opens an approved package of lodging, transportation, meals, support hours, moving services, home setup, and other defined goods or services.

cards.name: Infinity Store Card
cards.surface: Physical or digital store card connected to Infinity Wallet
cards.purpose: Presents approved merchant offers, owned benefit units, purchased store value, receipts, returns, warranties, and delivery status through one user-controlled interface.

cards.name: Arrowhead Coin Card
cards.surface: Arrowhead-themed NFC card linked to a digital collectible and purchase record
cards.purpose: Connects the earlier Arrowhead Coin and Luxury Click–Infinity Drop concept to limited products, auctions, collectibles, creator releases, and verified physical fulfillment.

cards.name: Black Card Market Record
cards.purpose: Records authenticated ownership, provenance, appraisal evidence, custody, and optional qualified third-party collateral review for high-value collectibles or property.

cards.name: Infinity Relic Card
cards.surface: Two-piece printed card with die-cut core, clear archival window or capsule, physical relic, and NFC/RFID inlay
cards.purpose: Seals a real coin, sapphire, mineral, memorabilia piece, expedition specimen, or other documented object into a numbered card tied to its digital record.

cards.name: Shop World Play Card
cards.purpose: Preserves the Mario Shop World prototype mechanics: grab items, review offers, accept or reject deals, charge bids, mint demonstration tokens, and build shopping combinations.

offers.name: Accessible Coastal Trial Stay
offers.priceLabel: 14 Stay Nights + 4 Ride Units + 20 Meal Units
offers.risk: Package must identify lodging, accessibility, return travel, cancellations, and provider responsibility.

offers.name: BeeNest Accessible Home Setup
offers.risk: Construction requires site, contract, permit, inspection, warranty, and licensed professional review.

offers.name: Serialized Coin Relic Card
offers.risk: Object identity, authenticity, ownership, weight, condition, and return terms must be independently documented.

offers.name: Research Article Access Pass
offers.risk: License and access period must be clear; the pass does not transfer copyright ownership.

offers.name: Shop World Demo Token Bundle × 10
offers.risk: No cash value, withdrawal, investment return, or external transfer.

offers.name: Expired Gift Card Review
offers.risk: Clearly flag expiration, unusable value, fees, and bad-deal conditions before acceptance.

modules.name: Infinity Wallet
modules.role: Shows cards, approved units, store value, receipts, holds, returns, and ownership records.

modules.name: Infinity Market
modules.role: Buy, sell, trade, auction, or redeem verified goods and digital access through documented offers.

modules.name: Infinity Stage
modules.role: Three-dimensional or visual storefronts for merchants, creators, properties, destinations, and collections.

modules.name: Luxury Click–Infinity Drop
modules.role: Limited releases, auctions, creator drops, and Arrowhead Coin card experiences.

modules.name: Black Card Market
modules.role: Restricted high-value property records, provenance, custody, and qualified collateral review.

modules.name: Shop World
modules.role: Gamified consumer education and shopping demonstration based on grab, accept, reject, bid, and combo mechanics.

modules.name: Boron Vault
modules.role: Separates viewing from signing and protects real credentials through audited cryptography and hardware-backed controls.
